snippet.title: Mr Toilet - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨 THE TOILET OPENS MAY 13 🚨

Yes, we actually made a public toilet simulator.
Yes, it launches in Early Access on May 13.
And yes… people somehow enjoy it.

In Mr Toilet, you’ll:
🚽 manage a public restroom
🚽 charge people for using it
🚽 clean absolute disasters
🚽 become the bathroom boss

Get it now before society collapses 
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930150/Mr_Toilet

#MrToilet #indiegame #simulation
